sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Jewel Treasure is the match 3 gameplay mechanic. The game requires players to swap adjacent tiles to create sets of three or more jewels in a row either horizontally or vertically. The jewels can be matched in different combinations, such as three in a row, four in a square, or five in a L-shape.

The game also features power-ups and boosters that can be used to help players complete levels or make progress. These power-ups include items such as extra lives, extra moves, and special jewels that can be used to clear entire rows or columns.

One of the unique features of Jewel Treasure is its use of combinations. Players can create special combinations of jewels, such as a T-shape or an L-shape, to clear multiple tiles at once. This adds a new level of strategy to the game, as players must think ahead and plan their moves carefully.

As players progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging. New obstacles and challenges are introduced, such as locked tiles, moving tiles, and special tiles that can be cleared in different ways. The game's difficulty level increases gradually, making it a great challenge for players of all skill levels.
